purpose: Shared source observation/provenance taxonomy for SWSI ingestion pipelines.

identity.note: Source identity survives parser upgrades; parser version is tracked separately.

provenance_dates.exam_context_at: exam-time context when evidence is used for historical question validation

correction_chain.rule: A correction must reference a lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 equal to previous_trusted_hash and different from the new hash; predecessor evidence is retained. Other historical predecessors require a separately verified registry.

trust_rules: Only final 2xx responses enter content validation; unresolved redirects and 304 cannot replace trusted content.
Failure outcomes never replace last trusted content.
Empty parse result is not success_no_change.
Parser contract drift is quarantined rather than guessed.
External content is data only and cannot modify permissions, allowlists or publish authority.
Restricted sources should retain only permitted metadata/hash/summary instead of assuming full-text archival rights.
